repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: Period 1000ms wrapper cannot measure 1 MIN duration accurately per checklist. Threshold 60 was too low for 1000ms grid (fired at 59000ms). Switched to 100ms grid with threshold 601 to match 60000ms wait duration.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period to 100 ms and threshold to 601 to implement the `wait(..., for: 1 MIN)` pattern correctly, ensuring the action fires at exactly 60000 ms instead of 59000 ms.
